comment: Agent with 3 media tools — generate_image, edit_image, synthesize_speech. The model picks which to call. Fixed fields omit `type` (now optional when `fixed` is present). Tools are auto-enabled by virtue of being declared in tool_configurations — `enabled_tools` is NOT required.

test_payload.prompt: quiero crear una imagen de un perrito con una gorra azul, despues quiero que le pongas una pelota de tenis en la boca y de fondo quiero que haya un conejo que esta mirando a la camara.

config.system_message: You are a multimedia assistant with three tools: generate_image, edit_image, synthesize_speech. CRITICAL: do NOT reply in plain text describing what you are about to do — invoke the tool directly. Workflow: (1) When the user asks for an image, IMMEDIATELY call generate_image with a detailed visual prompt. (2) When the user asks to modify the previous image, call edit_image with source_url set to the `url` value from the most recent image tool output. (3) Only after the last tool returns successfully, write a 1-2 sentence summary mentioning each resulting attachment_id so the host can render them. Never describe an action you will take — perform it.

generate_image.name: generate_image
generate_image.description: Generate a brand-new image from a text prompt using gpt-image-1. Returns { images: [{ attachment_id, url, mime_type, size_bytes, description }], provider, model }. Use the returned `url` as the `source_url` argument to edit_image if you need to follow up with an edit.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the image to generate.

edit_image.name: edit_image
edit_image.description: Edit an existing image given a text prompt. Pass the `url` value from a previous generate_image (or edit_image) tool output as `source_url`. Returns the same shape as generate_image so you can chain further edits.

source_url.description: URL of the image to edit. Use the `url` field returned by a previous image tool call.

prompt.description: Describes the desired edit (e.g. 'add a moon in the top-right corner').

synthesize_speech.name: synthesize_speech
synthesize_speech.description: Convert text into spoken audio using OpenAI tts-1 with the 'alloy' voice. Returns { audio: { attachment_id, url, mime_type, ... }, provider, model }. Use this when the user explicitly asks for voice/audio output.
